name: chat
description: A conversation region: a named area holding a transcript and a composer. A person keeps several chats and moves between them from its menu, and can open it in a window of its own. A block like any other: move it to a pane, restyle it or remove it.

use.when: the conversation belongs on the canvas beside the person's content; it is always at /chat as well.
use.with: a pane, when the person wants it beside what they are working on.

label.description: Names the region, so landmark navigation can reach it.

layout.title: Look
layout.description: panel shows the title; bare keeps it for screen readers only, to sit inside another surface.

slot.description: The transcript and composer, put in by the server; text from a model or a form is escaped.

keyboard.does: moves through the transcript's links and the composer

wcag.notes: A named region, so it is reachable by landmark navigation wherever it is placed (2.4.1). The title stays in the accessibility tree in bare layout, so removing the visual chrome never removes the name. The transcript is a list, so turn counts are announced.

machine.identify: A section whose accessible name is the label. The transcript is the list inside it and the composer is its form. The menu at the top names the current chat and lists the others.
machine.operate: Fill the textbox named by its label and activate the submit button. New chat starts another chat; each chat in the list opens with its own button, and Delete removes it. Where it sits is asked of the assistant. If this region has been removed from the canvas, the same conversation is always at /chat and POST /api/chat.
